name: ai-music-short-studio
description: AI Music Short Studio — create musical audiovisual shorts with AI, with the user approving every generated asset.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ams/server && npm run build -w @ams/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @ams/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -b packages/server packages/web --pretty
scripts.demo: npm run build:shared && npm run demo -w @ams/server
